test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 05 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which of the following Indian states is Lokrang festival observed?
solution:
The correct answer is Madhya Pradesh.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lokrang festival observed in Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The Lokrang Festival is celebrated on 26th January every year.
 
• It is celebrated for 5 days.
 
• The Madhya Pradesh Adivasi Lok Kala Academy organizes the event.
 
• The festival's actual motive is to erase the geopolitical demarcations of India.
 
• It is held in the city of Bhopal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Bhopal is the capital of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• It is also the administrative headquarters of both Bhopal district and Bhopal division.
 
• It is known as the City of Lakes.
